more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Beta-apo-8'-carotenal is a carotenoid aldehyde whose specified colouring material consists mainly of the all-trans form. It is used to add colour or restore colour lost during food manufacture. The specified material is supplied as powder or crystalline material. EU permissions include processed cheese, fruit and vegetable preparations excluding compote, processed fish and fishery products including molluscs and crustaceans.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; flavoured drinks; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products; unripened cheese excluding products falling in category 16.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
In 2026, JECFA noted that a high dietary exposure estimate for toddlers exceeded its existing intake limit.
The limit was based on animal evidence; exceedance alone does not establish a clinical effect.
